title: DSL code display on voyage dashboard
description: User cannot see the current best DSL on the voyage page, making it hard to evaluate what the agent is doing. Add a collapsible details section to voyage.html that fetches and displays the DSL file content, polled alongside other live data.
definition-of-done: 1. Collapsible details section added to voyage.html after 3D Preview. 2. Poll function fetches DSL file from /ixdar/dsl/voyage_REF.dsl. 3. DSL code displayed in pre element with monospace font.
testing-plan: 1. Visit /voyage/skull/ with Hugo dev server. 2. Best DSL Code section visible. 3. Click to expand, code matches voyage_skull.dsl content.
